Putin releases U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard, who fought on Ukraine’s side
October 21, 2026, 9:42 am
Source: TASS
Russian President Vladimir Putin said U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard, who fought on Ukraine’s side and was convicted by a Russian court of mercenary activity, has been released. Putin made the announcement at the start of a meeting with U.S. presidential envoy Steve Witkoff.
Hubbard is already at Pulkovo Airport in St. Petersburg, Putin said.
Hubbard, who was 72 at the time, was sentenced in Russia in October 2024 to six years and 10 months in prison on mercenary charges. In the first days of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, Hubbard joined the territorial defense in the Kharkiv region, where he had lived for many years, and in April 2022 he was captured by Russian forces.
The New York Times reported the day before that Witkoff would try to secure Hubbard’s release during his trip to Russia in order to “to show the benefits of deal-making” with Putin.

titulekPuvodni: Russia’s FSB says it detained German citizen who fought for Ukraine
shrnuti: Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) said Russian law enforcement authorities detained a German citizen who allegedly signed a contract with the Ukrainian army and deserted.

vyrez.text:
Russia’s FSB says it detained German citizen who fought for Ukraine — Meduza
Skip to main content
Russia’s FSB says it detained German citizen who fought for Ukraine
October 21, 2026, 9:13 am
Source: Interfax
Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) said Russian law enforcement authorities detained a German citizen who allegedly signed a contract with the Ukrainian army and deserted.
The man arrived in Ukraine in November 2025 and signed a three-year contract to serve in the Ukrainian armed forces, the agency said, but deserted because he had not received the money he had been promised.
The FSB did not say how he ended up in Russia. A criminal case has been opened against him on charges of mercenary activity.
According to the FSB, the man took part in combat operations in Afghanistan as part of the German contingent from 2004 to 2010. He also fought in the armed conflict in Somalia from 2006 to 2008, served as a mercenary in Syria from 2008 to 2010, and fought in eastern Ukraine on the side of the Ukrainian armed forces from 2016 to 2018, the agency said.

Authors:

It is planned to introduce the State Defence Service (VAD) into the State Border Guard from 2028, as announced by Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) following a conceptual decision taken during the closed part of Tuesday’s cabinet meeting, LSM.lv reports.
It is envisaged that the Ministry of the Interior will collaborate with the Ministry of Defence on the introduction of the VAD within the Border Guard, including the resources actually required and the additional financial resources needed by each of the institutions involved.
The state budget bill will consider the additional funding required to introduce the VAD within the Border Guard, in accordance with the state budget’s financial capacity.
Introducing defence service within the State Border Guard would strengthen border protection capabilities while also giving young people the opportunity to undertake national defence service…

Von Florian Flade , WDR
Der Zufallsfund eines Landwirts in Niedersachsen sorgt bei der Bundeswehr für eine Neubewertung der Sicherheitslage: Mitte September wurde unweit des Fliegerhorsts Wunstorf eine offenbar abgestürzte Drohne entdeckt . Sie ähnelt in der Konstruktion jener mit Sprengstoff bestückten Drohne, die Anfang August beim gescheiterten Anschlag auf dem Flughafen Leipzig/Halle eingesetzt wurde.

Published: 21.10.26 03:07 , Update: 21.10.26 03:25
The incident at Fairford airbase prompted a major security scare
© AFP
UK police said Tuesday they have re-arrested two men on suspicion of spying for Iran, amid an investigation into a security scare at a British airbase used by the United States.
Counter-terrorism police said a 24-year-old British citizen and a 25-year-old UK-Iranian dual national, both from London, were arrested "on suspicion of assisting a foreign intelligence service" over last month's incident at the Fairford base in southwest England.
"The country to which the investigation relates is Iran," the police statement said.
The United States abruptly withdrew all its B-1 bombers from the Royal Air Force (RAF) site earlier this month after the incident there on September 27.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said Iran's Revolutionary Guards "almost certainly directed" the major scare, which remained shrouded in mystery and speculation.

Source: TVP
Polish Border Guard officers detained 15 Russian and Belarusian citizens who apparently intended to compete in the world karate championships for youth, junior, and under-21 athletes in Bielsko-Biała.
The detainees — 11 Belarusians and four Russians — entered Poland on tourist visas, which, according to Border Guard spokesperson Szymon Mościcki, “did not match the stated purpose of their stay.” All were ordered to leave the country within eight days.
The karate championships took place from September 14 to 18. Polish authorities had barred Russian athletes from the outset. The Russian Karate Federation said it “had anticipated this situation and therefore had not recommended that anyone take part in this tournament,” but also “could not stand in the way of the athletes’ own wishes” to compete in the event.

Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Za mřížemi klece pro obžalované vypadal jako kterýkoli ruský občan předvolaný před lefortovský obvodní soud v Moskvě. Tím spíš, že mu ruská zpravodajská služba FSB, která ho před soud dostala, rozmazala na snímcích ze soudní síně obličej.
Jenže potíž je, že 14. října v Lefortovu nestál ruský občan. Za soudními mřížemi se totiž ocitl Japonec, konkrétně reportér japonských novin Hokkaidó Šimbun, které, jak napovídá už jejich název, působí hlavně na severojaponském ostrově Hokkaidó.
Ale nejen tam. Dotyčný novinář totiž svou pracovní základnu nemá v hokkaidském ústředním městě Sapporu, ale v bezmála 500 kilometrů vzdáleném Južno-Sachalinsku, což znamená v Rusku.

shrnuti: Komentář: V Paříži se výbuchy násilí surreálně proplétají s rytmem francouzského života.

vyrez.text:
Byl jsem v Paříži a viděl jsem, jak ve městě světel zavládla tma — Deník N
Šéf francouzského svazu zaměstnavatelů MEDEF Patrick Martin před vyrabovanou restaurací (19. října 2026). Obchod padl za oběť nepokojům a rabování, ke kterým došlo o dva dny dříve během celostátních protestů. Foto: Alexis Jumeau, ABACA / Abaca Press / Profimedia
Komentář: V Paříži se výbuchy násilí surreálně proplétají s rytmem francouzského života.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Všechno je jednou poprvé, i zásah slzným plynem. Pokud jste se 17. října zrovna nalézali v Paříži, šance, že se vám to stane, byla poměrně značná. Plakáty, jimiž byly polepené ulice východní části města, ten den nazývaly „Revolucí 17. října“.
Tonton Lulu je jedna z těch typických, nikterak nabubřelých kaváren, na něž v Paříži natrefíte na každém rohu. Tato konkrétní se nachází na Avenue Ledru-Rollin, jen pár set metrů západně od náměstí Bastily. To se v této části města stalo epicentrem nepokojů, které vypukly pod záminkou nespokojenosti se stavem školství a pod hlavičkou „dne boje proti drahotě“. Off Hiiumaa island, German warship wrecks from 1916 are ticking ecological time bombs, holding thousands of liters of oil that could pollute Baltic Sea coastlines if released.
The German torpedo boats S57 , V72 and V75 sank in November 1916 after straying into a minefield during a failed attack on the port of Paldiski.
A new study by researchers from the Estonian Maritime Museum (EMM) and Finland, led by Ivar Treffner, assessed the wrecks and the environmental threat they pose.
At the time, navies had only just begun transitioning from coal to liquid fuel. The ships went down carrying thousands of liters of heavy fuel oil, which remains trapped inside their hulls today.

Image source, Anadolu via Getty Images
Image caption, More than 200 people were arrested across the weekend, according to Italian media
By Hafsa Khalil
Published
8 hours ago
Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is poised to approve emergency security measures, according to local media, after protests over rising costs broke out into violent clashes in Milan.
The measures include extending preventative detention to minors and restricting group gatherings, Milanese paper Corriere della Sera reported.
Police deployed tear gas and water cannons after protesters - many in masks - threw paving stones, bins and chairs at officers over the weekend. More than 250 people were detained, 80% of whom were minors, Italian police said.
The expected crackdown comes after Meloni chaired an emergency security meeting on Monday afternoon. No official announcements have been made.
More than 5,000 people gathered in Milan over the weekend. As well as clashes between police and some protesters, stores were looted and property was set on fire.

shrnuti: Båtfolket i Oslofjorden blir bedne om å sjekke båten for den uønskte arten hamnespy. Forskarar er redde effekten han kan ha på ein fjord som allereie slit.

– Journalist
Journalist
Publisert
19.10.2026, kl. 13.19
– Det er ei tikkande bombe som ventar på å eksplodere.
Det seier marinbiolog og seniorrådgivar i WWF Fredrik Myhre om arten kjent som hamnespy.
Japansk sjøpung, kjend som hamnespy, er ikkje ønskt i Noreg.
Foto: Åge Wee / NTB
Japansk sjøpung (Didemnum vexillum), som den eigentleg heiter, er rekna som ein framandart i Noreg.
Han legg seg som eit gulgrått teppe på skrog og tauverk, og kveler anna liv i havet. Foreløpig finst han berre på Vestlandet, men spreiing til Oslofjorden blir rekna som eit tidsspørsmål.
Båtfolk i området blir bedne om å sjekke båten nøye når han blir tatt opp for vinteren.
– For ein fjord som allereie slit så mykje som Oslofjorden gjer, ville det vere dramatisk å få inn ein såpass invaderande art, seier Myhre.
– Spesielt om han skulle få fritt spelerom til å spreie seg.

French presidential candidate Gabriel Attal reiterated his call to grant the government power to selectively block access to social media platforms to quell riots in the aftermath of widespread unrest across France over the weekend .
“You have young people at home who see their friends going out to loot, which gives the impression that they’re getting away with it; they see them on social media, and then they go out too,” Attal said in an interview with French radio station RTL .
Attal, a former prime minister who now leads French President Emmanuel Macron’s political party, said the measures must be “temporary” and “limited to the area where the riots are taking place.”

shrnuti: In August, a sabotage attempt took place at Leipzig Airport in Germany, which the German government has said was carried out by Russia. One of the suspected organizers of the attack is a Latvian citizen by the name of Oļegs Ļevuškins (Oleg Levushkin).

In August, a sabotage attempt took place at Leipzig Airport in Germany, which the German government has said was carried out by Russia. One of the suspected organizers of the attack is a Latvian citizen by the name of Oļegs Ļevuškins (Oleg Levushkin).
The Latvian Television programme investigative programme De Facto revealed on October 18th that Levushkin had been in business in Russia for almost 18 years as the owner of a Latvian pharmaceutical company called "Elpis".
The State Security Service (VDD) confirmed to De Facto that it has already initiated the procedure to revoke Levushkin's Latvian citizenship.
Leipzig Airport is one of the main routes for delivering military aid to Ukraine. On the evening of August 4 this year, a drone crashed into the wing of a Ukrainian cargo plane there, very close to its fuel tank. The drone contained explosives, but the detonator did not go off.…

Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv Oblast leaves 3 missing | Ukrainska Pravda
Photo: Mykhailyna Skoryk on Facebook
Russian forces have launched a large-scale combined attack on Kyiv Oblast using attack drones, ballistic missiles and cruise missiles, leaving people injured and causing damage. Three people have also been reported missing.
Source: Tymur Tkachenko, Head of Kyiv Oblast Military Administration, on Telegram
Quote from Tkachenko: "Six people have been injured in Irpin, Bucha district, including three children. Another three people are missing. Search operations are currently underway."
Advertisement:





Details: Tkachenko added that 11 houses, six cars, industrial and warehouse premises and an educational institution were damaged in the Bucha district. Windows were shattered in apartment buildings.

ROME – The boss cannot speak right now. And on the streets chaos has erupted. Fourteen bombs in four months, caught in a cycle of score-settling and gunfire. In Rome, every show of power is settled with violence.
In the Italian capital, there is a power vacuum that organized crime is exploiting, aided by the silence of the institutions. And so the explosions keep coming, one after another, always in the same part of the city: the southeast quadrant, home to nearly a million people. It is the domain of the Senese clan.
The boss known as O’ Pazz
The boss is Michele Senese, known as O’ Pazz ( The madman ), because he reportedly spent years trying to avoid prison by feigning madness. His roots trace back to the bloody Camorra wars—the powerful mafia organization originating in Naples— between Nuova Famiglia and Raffaele Cutolo's Nuova Camorra Organizzata, a conflict that left hundreds dead in the 1980s.

Published

An Austrian Airlines flight from Israel to Austria was forced to divert to Bulgaria after a reported bomb threat.
The Airbus A320 plane was travelling from Tel Aviv to Vienna on Sunday night but made an emergency landing in Sofia, where passengers were evacuated, the Bulgarian transport ministry said in a statement.
The Bulgarian air force scrambled a MiG-29 fighter jet to escort the airliner, the statement said. No injuries have been reported and an investigation has begun.
It comes after a pilot attempted to hijack a Flydubai flight en route to Tel Aviv last month by attacking the captain, before the flight's crew and passengers overpowered him and landed the plane safely in Saudi Arabia.
Bulgarian and Israeli media reported that a bomb threat had been made.

titulekPuvodni: Cyberattack on French supermarkets tells us more about food security than AI safety
shrnuti: Experts know little about the motives of the hackers who remotely turned up the temperature on French supermarket refrigerators. Their methods, however, are far from science fiction.

vyrez.text:
Cyberattack on French supermarkets tells us more about food security than AI safety – POLITICO
Skip to main content
Advertisement
The cyberattack last week that hit hundreds of French supermarket refrigerators had Europeans wondering if the nonstop warnings about AI risks had finally landed in the real world.
They hadn't — at least, not yet.
Experts say the attack, which forced hundreds of retailers to throw away defrosted food and spoiled milk, was mostly a reminder of the importance of old-school cybersecurity in safeguarding essential goods and services.
Advertisement
The attack is a “typical example” of how “low-key cyber-enabled sabotage can affect very crucial supply for society,” said Ferdinand Gehringer, hybrid threats lead at FTI Consulting.
It’s arguably the most consequential hack in the European Union this year, with tangible, disruptive real-world repercussions. France’s Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu personally managed the fallout, which prompted coordination and information-sharing at the EU level. 
The perpetrators, whose identity and motives are currently unknown, hacked into digital systems to remotely raise the temperature of refrigerators in supermarkets…

'Very upsetting': Residents in shock after historic French town hall set alight
'Very upsetting': Residents in shock after historic French town hall set alight Close
A historic town hall in the French city of Limoges has been damaged in an apparent arson attack following a day of nationwide protests on Saturday.
Dramatic footage shared online shows the 19th-century building engulfed in flames, with the spire of its clock tower later collapsing.
On Sunday, stunned residents watched as firefighters, who had battled the blaze through the night, assessed the building's structural integrity. Officials have not yet confirmed whether the town hall is at risk of collapse.
"Damaging heritage buildings because you're angry with the government is selfish", one resident told the BBC.
BBC correspondent Chris Bockman reports from Limoges.
Read more about the protests across France.

Na Moskvu během sobotního ukrajinského útoku mířilo okolo 200 dronů. Jde o neobvykle vysoký počet. Dvě tamní letiště přerušila provoz.
Článek
Ruská protivzdušná obrana v sobotu zachytila a zničila téměř 200 ukrajinských dronů mířících na Moskvu. Uvedl to v noci na neděli starosta ruské metropole Sergej Sobjanin na platformě Telegram.
Sobjanin v sérii příspěvků na internetu uvedl, že od předchozí půlnoci bylo zničeno 195 dronů a že na místě dopadu trosek zasahovaly záchranné složky.
Ruský úřad pro civilní letectví (Rosaviacija) oznámil, že dvě moskevská letiště - Domodědovo a Vnukovo - pozastavila provoz.
Jednotky protivzdušné obrany proti dronům mířícím na hlavní město a jeho okolí zasahují často, avšak takto vysoký počet je neobvyklý.

Governments have rushed to grapple with the rising threat brought by AI's ability to expose and exploit cybersecurity vulnerabilities. Při ruských nočních útocích na Ukrajinu přišlo o život nejméně šest lidí, píše agentura AFP s odvoláním na místní úřady. Tři lidé zahynuli v Kyjevě, dva v Dněpropetrovské oblasti a jeden v Záporožské oblasti.
V metropoli Rusko zasáhlo balistickými střelami energetická zařízení a ve městě nastaly výpadky dodávek elektřiny, uvedl ráno starosta ukrajinské metropole Vitalij Kličko. Podle prezidenta Volodymyra Zelenského byly ruské noční útoky zaměřené na ukrajinskou energetickou infrastrukturu, na kterou se má vztahovat energetické příměří…

EU lawmakers urged the bloc’s executive to robustly defend the International Criminal Court against U.S. sanctions in a letter sent to Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Tuesday and obtained by POLITICO. “We formally call for the urgent deployment of all instruments at our disposal to protect the International Criminal Court from the consequences of these sanctions,” reads the letter, signed by 58 MEPs, led by ECON chair and S&D lawmaker Aurore Lalucq and EPP Dutch lawmaker Dirk Gotink. titulekPuvodni: "She loved the children and her work so much": the kindergarten teacher killed in a Russian attack on Kyiv

Kindergarten teacher killed in Russian drone attack on Kyiv's Darnytskyi district | Ukrainska Pravda
Tetiana and Mykola Musiienko. Photo: screenshot from Aliona Musiienko's Instagram
On the evening of 12 October, a high-rise building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district was hit by a Russian drone just as Tetiana Musiienko and her husband Mykola were walking past. The 59-year-old kindergarten teacher was killed and her husband is in a serious condition.
Source: Tetiana and Mykola's daughter Aliona Musiienko on Instagram
Details: Aliona said her parents were right next to where the impact occurred. Mykola had met his wife from work, as he did every day, and they were walking home together. The couple were just 50 metres away from the apartment building where they lived.

Tetiana worked as a teacher at kindergarten No. 166.
